report.answer: Control set against validate.py (bare CLI, isolated copies): 15/16 firing rate (15 killed, 1 survived). The known no-op is M16-V-FIELDS-defaults-deleted: deleting the catalog defaults block exits 0 because require_complete defaults False and the invocation omits --require-complete. The same mutation exits non-zero with the arming flag (reviewer armed_exit=1). A mutation that SHOULD be caught (M01 dangling dependency) is KILLED (exit=1), so the census is a rate not a survivors-only list. Historical REACH-6 blank-digest and CRLF-hash reverts are KILLED by isolated regression analogs. The DEFAULT_MIN_BYTES shape survives in _p2lib.write_if_valid (default 1 never exercised; every emitter passes min_bytes_threshold explicitly). B08 mutation-gate outputs are ABSENT on this worktree; the control set fills that gap. Shared gate sources were byte-identical before and after (c9d09ca91a7db064…).
